name: Roleplay v2 Rehearsal Judge — Full-Session Rubric Evaluator
description: Scores ONE full_session agent test case's rubrics (criteria + scoring instructions) against ONE rehearsal transcript, judging the runtime (actor + director), not the scripted FULL_SESSION trainee. Per rubric: 0-100 score with verbatim [turn N] evidence and reasoning, plus overall_score and summary_markdown. Contains literal JSON braces, so the runtime resolves it via load_template and appends the spec manually; code deterministically clamps scores, realigns rubric_scores to the request order, and recomputes overall_score as the mean after the LLM call.
